access_boundary: This record represents the GPT-5.1-Codex Mini line launched November 13, 2025 as the smaller sibling of GPT-5.1-Codex, served only as the rotating gpt-5.1-codex-mini alias with no fixed dated revision; OpenAI shut the API down on July 23, 2026, naming gpt-5.6-terra the substitute. The Codex and Max siblings, Codex application behaviors, later Codex generations, fine-tuned derivatives, and the OpenAI API platform itself are separate service, application, or model boundaries.

tradeoffs: No developer-published weights are available for self-operation or independent deployment
